messages:
alex: heads up — after v3.14 rollout we saw a burst of 413s and a gap in embed telemetry.
priya: 413 = Payload Too Large? need to know if reject happened at proxy or our splitter.
alex: both. nginx returned 413 for some; our splitter accepted mixed-dim arrays and created batches; runtime SIGTERM canceled inflight batches. logs:
```
[2026-02-18T03:12:07Z] embed-runtime: assembled batch id=42 size=512 dims=[1536,1536,768]
[2026-02-18T03:12:09Z] embed-runtime: SIGTERM received
[2026-02-18T03:12:09Z] embed-runtime: canceling inflight batch id=42 write error: broken pipe
[2026-02-18T03:12:09Z] nginx: 413 POST /v1/embeddings from 10.1.2.3
```
mike: rolling shutdown + batching = dropped requests. plan: drain inflight batches before exit for a configurable window.
sarah: agree. plus we need distinguishable telemetry tags: rejected_by=proxy vs rejected_by=splitter vs dropped=during_drain.

priya: telemetry proposal:
- embed.requests.total
- embed.responses.413.splitter
- embed.responses.413.proxy
- embed.drop.drain_timeout
- embed.batch.drain_time (histogram)

mike: implementation notes: on SIGTERM, routing marks node DRAINING and stops new assigns, runtime finishes existing batches up to drain_timeout (default 10s). if batch can't finish, fail with 503 + header `X-Embed-Dropped-Reason: drain_timeout`.
jordan: routing nuance: for requests that will be split, prefer local split rather than reroute if size > split_threshold to avoid double-splitting and extra latency.

alex: API UX: add conservative split hints in headers for client SDKs when we reject with 413: `X-Embed-Suggest-Splits: max_chunk_bytes=512000,prefer_dim_group=1536`.
sarah: also emit `X-Embed-AutoSplit: 1` when we auto-split and include sampled batch ids in `X-Embed-AutoSplit-Ids`.

priya: console ask: new tile showing embed.drop by reason + recent dimension histogram, plus SLO alert when embed.drop.drain_timeout > 0.1% for 5m.

action items:
- mike: add graceful drain + drain_timeout config, record embed.batch.drain_time (owner: mike)
- priya: splitter telemetry counters, sampled examples, and 413 attribution (owner: priya)
- sarah: console tile + alert (owner: sarah)
- jordan: routing policy for large-split preference + doc (owner: jordan)
- docs: client guidance for 413 and SDK auto-split behavior

deploy-bot: deploy started embed-runtime v3.14 -> rolling 5 nodes
mike: will open PR with unit tests and a small e2e sim today.
alex: thanks — let's monitor embed.batch.drain_time after rollout and post a short update.
